title: On Assigning the northern fields to my uncle
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：assign　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 assign 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the farmer ① assigned the northern fields to my uncle at once, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② assigns the northern fields to my uncle in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ assign the northern fields to my uncle at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ assigned the northern fields to my uncle before — a line in the almanac for September 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Assigning the northern fields to my uncle at once, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ assign a page of homework in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Assign a page of homework at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ assigns a page of homework at once every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ assigned the northern fields to my uncle again when nobody else would.

⑩ To assign the northern fields to my uncle, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody assigns the northern fields to my uncle in the rain again and somebody must assign the northern fields to my uncle at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 分配（一般过去式 assigned the northern fields to my uncle：1977 年农人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 分配（一般现在 assigns the northern fields to my uncle：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 分配（不定式 to assign the northern fields to my uncle：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 分配（过去完成时 had assigned the northern fields to my uncle：1971 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 分配（动名词 assigning the northern fields to my uncle 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 布置（assign a page of homework：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去布置一页作业）
G. v. 布置（assign a page of homework：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 分配（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 assigns a page of homework，而母亲又一次 assigned the northern fields to my uncle）

assign 意为“分配”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要分配把北边几块地分给我叔叔，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

answers: In 1977 the farmer assigned the northern fields to my uncle at once, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer assigns the northern fields to my uncle in the rain whenever the field asks.
